messages:
maria-cust: Hey team — after yesterday's scheduled model refresh our embeddings started returning length=512 but the index expects 768. we've got production errors.

julia: sorry to hear that, can you paste the request/response example?

maria-cust: here's the call we're making (node):

```js
const resp = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.RW_KEY}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-embed-legacy', input: ['hello world'] })
})
const j = await resp.json()
console.log(j)
```

maria-cust: response payload shows: `embedding: [0.12, 0.05, ...]` length = 512

julia: ok noted. did you have the model pinned in the dashboard or are you on hosted?

maria-cust: we're on Dedicated Reserved, and we had a pin to `redwood-embed-legacy:2024-11-01` — we thought that would freeze shape.

sam-eng: quick hypothesis: reserved backend performed a variant substitution to a quantized shard (512) to meet capacity. pin might have locked version but not variant. can you send the raw response headers and any deploy bot messages around the time?

maria-cust: attaching header snippet from the request: `x-rw-model: redwood-embed-legacy`, `x-rw-variant: redwood-embed-legacy-q8_512`, `x-rw-model-version: 2024-11-01`

julia: that header is the smoking gun — variant is different. the pinned version is correct but variant mapping bumped to q8_512.

derek-sre: deploy-bot: we did a capacity fallback earlier that replaced some instances with q8 variants in region us-west-2 at 2024-12-05T03:12Z. That was to avoid an OOM spike.

linh-ml: quick note: some quantized variants change output width when model re-compilation uses different embedding head. legacy v1 had 768 float32. q8 path collapses to 512. That's intended for that variant.

maria-cust: oof — so pinning version didn't prevent the variant fallback. any mitigation? we have embedding shape asserts in consumer code.

julia: immediate options: 1) pin to the explicit model variant id that guarantees 768 (we can expose the exact variant id), 2) reconfigure consumer to accept either size temporarily and backfill, or 3) we can roll back the capacity fallback in your pool while you migrate.

sam-eng: for a quick repro run this curl and grep the headers:

```bash
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-legacy","input":["test"]}' | grep -i x-rw-
```

sam-eng: that will show `x-rw-variant` returned.

maria-cust: ran it, confirmed `x-rw-variant: redwood-embed-legacy-q8_512`. thanks.

derek-sre: i've opened a capacity ticket to pause automatic fallback for cust-472 (your account) on the reserved pool; ETA 30m.

linh-ml: also creating a small compatibility shim on our side to make the embeddings metadata include a `vector_length` field in responses so clients can detect mismatches sooner.

julia: I'll send you the explicit variant id for 768 and we can pin at variant-level. for now, if you need immediate unblock, change index code to check `len(embedding)` and route vectors into separate indexes (512 vs 768) until we stabilize.

maria-cust: appreciate the quick triage. please keep me posted on the rollback.

derek-sre: rollback complete for your reserved pool; instances replaced with float32 variants. verify and confirm.

maria-cust: rechecked — embeddings now 768 again. customer pipeline green. thank you! :heart:

julia: filing a follow-up to update docs and add an alert for variant substitutions on reserved customers.

linh-ml: follow-up ticket #ENG-embed-984 created for metadata field and variant docs.

maria-cust: closing on our side. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
